A complete list of vendors and their information is listed on our website.

Our 18th season promises to be one of the best seasons yet! We’ve curated an incredible lineup of vendors, including but not limited to, French pastry chefs, an Italian deli, a Polish chef, a pizza maker, a coffee trailer, a market day patio with grilled lunch items from the market’s host, Skip’s Restaurant and Catering, a cheese vendor with old-world European cheeses, a bread bakery, and a host of farmers offering everything from organic produce, fruits and meats to eggs, jams jellies and more.
